acceptable: All Gaul is divided into three parts
one of which the Belgae inhabit, the Aquitani another
in their own language are called Celts, in ours Gauls
The river Garonne separates the Gauls from the Aquitani

rights.source: C. Julius Caesar, De Bello Gallico 1.1, public-domain Latin text; W. A. McDevitte and W. S. Bohn, 1869 public-domain English translation.
